summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle at install time
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (setup.mjs) is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0x identifier renaming, indirection-object aliasing). On npm install it downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, writes it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses execFileSync to invoke it against math_init.js — a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (string-rotation shifter WV8StW, large character-code lookup array n7gIxM, opaque _0x identifiers). The package advertises itself as documentation content (files:["docs"], README describes docusaurus previews) and has no functional need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated JS payload. Running an obfuscated bundle via a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-based static analysis and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; installer machines execute arbitrary code on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
